reading.title: Should schools teach trades?
reading.text: Many parents still see university as the only route to success, but a growing number of educators advocate a different path. They argue that vocational training gives teenagers practical skills that employers urgently need. The idea often provokes heated debate. Critics are vocal about the risk of pushing students into low-paid jobs too early, while supporters invoke data showing that skilled technicians now earn more than many graduates. The evidence is still equivocal, yet one thing is clear: for some young people, working with their hands is not a fallback but a true vocation.
